integrity: The source-dependent input is the trace-pairing theorem in arXiv:2602.21708v3, which identifies the nilradical as locally free of rank equal to finite-flat degree minus distinct geometric-fiber cardinality and proves that the reduction is finite étale. Every further step is proved explicitly by local ring algebra; no finite experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: The classification is restricted to reduced connected bases in characteristic zero and to the minimal excess-one case. It does not classify higher-rank nilradicals or positive-characteristic behavior. An older equivalent finite-algebra lemma may exist under different terminology.
title: One excess multiplicity forces a doubled trivial sheet
